item.title: Trump Brings Xi & Putin Face-to-Face & the Fight to Protect Kids on Roblox | 11.20.26
item.description: President Trump wraps up his whirlwind Asia trip – and reassures Americans that we’re safe from cyber attacks from state actors. We look at what came out of the historic series of summits, and where things stand now on the cyber security front. With the public focused on cyber threats, one Senator is exposing another threat online – gaming platforms that leave our children vulnerable. And, in the gaming world, the highly controversial game Grand Theft Auto 6 makes history with record sales. Reporting from Cabot Phillips. Plus, we speak with Senator Josh Hawley of Missouri & cohost of the PlayStation podcast Sacred Symbols, Colin Moriarty.
